title: Postcard and Letters
author: Astrid Nystrom
blurb: Casper Kavanagh, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
